extensionDescription.message: Fill logins and verification codes from KeeForge, the KeePass password manager for Mac.

hostMissing.message: Set up this browser in KeeForge: Settings, Browsers

inFrame.message: in a frame on this page

badOrigin.message: This page cannot be filled. Use a secure website.

noFields.message: No visible, editable fields on this page.

noLongerMatches.message: This entry no longer matches the site.

notOffered.message: Reopen the popup to refresh logins.

rateLimited.message: Too many requests. Try again shortly.

disabled.message: Filling from browser extensions is turned off in KeeForge. Turn it on in Settings, Browsers.

disconnected.message: The connection closed. Reopen the popup.

unavailable.message: KeeForge or this entry is unavailable.

timeout.message: The request timed out. Try again.

pairBusy.message: Pairing cannot start right now. Try again in a minute.

paired.message: Paired with KeeForge. You can close this tab.

compareCode.message: Check that KeeForge shows the same code, then click Allow there.

switchToApp.message: If KeeForge does not come forward, switch to it.
